Variants.Content: Carrodunum households rely on food, herds, woodland and exchange. Mounts and dependants need guards; long absence makes prizes poor compensation for harvest.

Carrodunum farming, herds, woodland and exchange sustain Vandal households. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Long absence makes prizes poor compensation for lost harvest.
